content: Iabialam Paulo, Sailas a Timoto, wabim zogometa Tesalonikage muige Baba Ad a Ople Iesu Keriso. Adira omar a mapodan wabim.
Ki gair kerkerge Adi eswao wabim waikelare waba nei odarabgelare kerbi erkepasamge.
Kiki mena wabi wadikepwalare meriba Ad a Baba opem waba dorge owaturge, waba meregsusapit omarge a wa barkak erkepwaikoslare abim meriba Ople Iesu Keriso.
Buai, Adide wabi omarge dikereda, ki umele dale E wabi ditutirda,
Ableglam ki debe mir wabim taisa nole no mir tebteb epe sasrim ko ableglam able mir barkak ike. Wa umele ki nako waurder nade ki wabi doge wadale wabi debeleem.
Wa kerbi doge a Oplege takmeirda. Wa asiasi tidigida a wage mir erpeidarda a sererge baprekerda Lamar Zogolam.
Able gair legize mir irmireda Masedoniage a Akaiage mokakalam pe wawa ikereda.
Oplera mir wabialam ebrerdi nole Masedoniage a Akaiage tebteb epe waba owatur Adi doge able mir ko ebrerdi gair gedge. Nole pa kerbim dike ki waderle daratagrare wabi owaturlam,
Ableglam wader legize kerbi detagreda wa nako wa kerbi derepda a wa nako wa Adim batarda able bes adilam ko agekar a idid Ad irmireda
a iako able werem dikailare mena e kotorlam watabakamu: abra werem Iesu ge e abi eudlam ikiamda a e merbi degderapda adud bodomalam pe tikaseredi.
